about.label: About Me

about.paragraph1: I'm a Software Engineer with a passion for building systems that are not only functional but elegantly architected. My work spans the full spectrum — from crafting pixel-perfect interfaces to designing distributed systems that handle millions of requests.
about.paragraph2: I believe that great software is built on solid principles. Every line of code should serve a purpose, every architecture decision should be deliberate, and every product should delight its users.
about.paragraph3: Focused on enterprise SaaS platforms, AI-powered products, and cloud-native architectures. Always learning, always building, always shipping.
